scope: Exploratory same-Store deterministic eviction/reread/hit closure plus balanced directed random switching; independent of SF-hot and historical four-condition experiments
random_design: Randomized Euler circuit of the directed three-model multigraph: every distinct directed edge exactly twice; no self transitions
timing_scope: One host controller activation-marker to parsed correct native business response; not HTTP TTFT. Full switch interval is previous backend exit-confirmation to next parsed correct response and includes the separately reported >=60s idle observation, scheduler, and container preparation. Old teardown begin/end and actual exit wall time are separate.
cache_policy: Natural Store eviction; no ClearMem/drop_caches/manual unload/preload. Initial empty Store; random phase inherits the proved full Kimi residency after fixed step5.
jit_policy: Reuse separate per-model copies of the completed full-v4 JIT caches; fresh GPU backend/engine each request.
release_policy: At least60 seconds empty-Store baseline, between every model teardown with only common Store GPU processes, and final all-GPU zero release.
failure_policy: Stop next model immediately on any failed gate, preserve originals and isolate own containers; no silent reruns
booking_basis: Existing approving user boyjiang qjhs003 reservations; live snapshot refresh attempted separately
random_initialization_source: Final Kimi activation of the fixed chain, recorded separately and not counted as a random switch
supersedes: Earlier candidate permitted self-transitions; user revised goal before random phase. Existing first fixed Kimi completes normally; same daemon adopted at an observed-exit boundary.
